comparison.objective: Place shielding bricks between two vials and a seat without disturbing the vials; candidate removes four tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Derived line-of-sight placement, upright balancing, and an inter-arm handoff versus coaxial tool alignment, striking, and fragment search.

comparison.reason: Geometric shielding placement and handoff are materially different from insert finishing.
